anomalies.expected: The design specification's component table states 'C5 | 0.1 µF | Decoupling cap on +3V3 (MAX3485 supply)'. A 0.1 µF (100 nF) ceramic is the intended local bypass for the MAX3485 supply; 100 pF is three orders of magnitude too small to serve that role.

C5 | 0.1 µF | Decoupling cap on +3V3 (MAX3485 supply).

anomalies.impact: The MAX3485 VCC pin is left essentially undecoupled (100 pF instead of 100 nF), so supply transients and ground bounce during TX/RX switching are not suppressed; this can cause receiver glitches and noisy operation on the shared serial servo bus.
